towns.name: Port St. Joe
towns.season: Quiet year round, busier in summer
towns.watch: Hurricane exposure. Michael hit hard here in 2018. The state closed the 2026 scallop season in St. Joseph Bay
towns.blurb: A small town on St. Joseph Bay, known for calm clear water, bay sunsets and the beaches of Cape San Blas.
towns.day: You paddle the clear grass flats in the morning, drive out to Cape San Blas for the beach and watch the sun set over the bay.
todo: A long, quiet peninsula of dunes and beach with a state park at the tip.
